subject: CloudWave PO handshake + vendor forms and onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudwave.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup & PO path for Redwood listing

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CloudWave is excited about bringing your inference offering onto our marketplace. Procurement asked me to start the vendor onboarding process so we can get the correct PO flow in place before the listing goes live. Quick checklist they asked for:

- Completed vendor registration form (company details, tax IDs)
- W9 (or W-8 if applicable) and primary billing contact
- Marketplace PO template filled and return path for invoices
- Expected start date and an initial committed spend (for internal ledger)

Can you confirm who will be the billing contact and whether Redwood has a marketplace billing account set up for AWS and GCP? Procurement prefers a single electronic invoicing path and a PO that matches the HubSpot deal id (DW-4729).

If easier, we can run a short call with procurement and finance to walk the forms.

Best,
Elena
Procurement Coordinator — CloudWave Systems

[Attachment: CloudWave_Request_Specs.pdf (pdf)]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudwave.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & PO path for Redwood listing

Thanks Elena — happy to take this on. Looping in Vanessa (sales ops) and Karthik (finance/procurements) to own the paperwork and PO mapping.

Short answers:
- Billing contact: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa@redwood.ai) — she owns marketplace finance flows.
- W9: attached (Redwood_W9.pdf).
- Marketplace billing accounts: we have active profiles for AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace; Azure requires a vendor enrollment (we can support but it typically adds 7-10 business days).

Proposed onboarding timeline:
1) Today: share vendor registration + W9 (attached) — Elena, please confirm the specific vendor registration URL you want us to use.
2) 1 business day: sales ops validates fields and returns Marketplace_PO_template.xlsx filled with our company and remittance details.
3) 2-5 business days: procurement to issue PO referencing DW-4729.
4) After PO: we complete any platform-specific seller enrollment (if Azure, +7-10 business days).

Attachments included: Redwood_W9.pdf, Marketplace_PO_template.xlsx (blank populated version).

If procurement wants a short sync to finalize the PO line items and start date, we can be available tomorrow afternoon.

— Marcus
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: procurement@cloudwave.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup & PO path for Redwood listing

Hi Vanessa / Marcus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is CloudWave_Vendor_Form.pdf — please complete pages 1-3 and include your remittance address on page 2. We also need the Marketplace_PO_template.xlsx filled as mentioned. A couple of clarifications for your finance team:

- PO number format: CW-YYYY-#### — please leave the PO number blank; procurement will populate it when issuing.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood must invoice monthly in arrears with net 45 payment terms. Our accounting system requires invoices to include the HubSpot deal id in the invoice reference.
- Tax considerations: please confirm if Redwood needs to submit a state tax nexus declaration; if not, indicate 'No nexus' on the vendor form.

We have a quick, optional DocuSign for the vendor declaration here: https://www.docusign.com/link/ZYX-123-cloudwave-po — completing it speeds processing. Targeting issuance of the PO by end of day Friday (2027-04-30) pending completed forms.

Regards,
CloudWave Procurement Team

[Attachment: CloudWave_Vendor_Form.pdf (fillable PDF)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudwave.com>, procurement@cloudwave.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup & PO path for Redwood listing

Elena — sending completed items now. Attached: CloudWave_Vendor_Form_filled.pdf and Marketplace_PO_template_completed.xlsx. Notes below:

- Remittance: Redwood Inference, 1203 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax nexus: No nexus — Redwood to be treated as out-of-state for CloudWave accounting purposes.
- Invoice cadence confirmed: monthly in arrears, net 45; invoices will include HubSpot deal id DW-4729 in the reference field.
- Azure enrollment: we'll initiate the Azure vendor enrollment once PO is issued; please confirm if you require any additional marketplace-specific attachments for Azure.

Vanessa will follow up once the PO number is assigned so we can map it to the listing activation. If you issue the PO by EOD as planned we'll target marketplace availability the week after PO clearance.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachments: CloudWave_Vendor_Form_filled.pdf, Marketplace_PO_template_completed.xlsx]
